description: Located in the Midwest, Omaha is celebrated for its urban vitality and appeal, earning it accolades as a top living destination. Its affordability and high-quality living create an ideal setting for people and businesses alike, including four Fortune 500 firms, including Warren Buffet's Berkshire Hathaway.
